summary: @onereach/font-icons ships preinstall dropper that fetches Bun runtime to execute obfuscated bundled payload
details: The package's preinstall hook (`node setup.mjs`) downloads the Bun runtime from GitHub releases, extracts and chmod+x's the binary into a temp directory, then invokes it to execute a shipped 727KB obfuscated `math_init.js` bundle. The package's advertised purpose is icon-font generation, which does not require an alternate language runtime or an opaque compiled bundle. Both the `setup.mjs` loader and the executed `math_init.js` are heavily obfuscated (obfuscator.io-style `_0x...` identifier renaming, string-array rotation, nested indirection maps), concealing the payload's behavior from source review and from Node-based scanners that would not natively execute a Bun bundle. The runtime fetch is used to run non-native, non-inspectable bytes shipped by the package rather than to build or run the icon-font tooling the README describes — an alternate-runtime dropper pattern that fires automatically on `npm install`.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
